questions.text: Fill in the blanks/Answer any seven of the following :

sub_questions.text: A 1.2% solution of organic compound is isotonic with 1.6% of urea ($\text{NH}_2\text{CONH}_2$) solution. The molecular weight of organic compound is —— a.m.u.
Hardness of water containing $1.46 \text{ mg/litre}$ magnesium bicarbonate and $1.36 \text{ mg/litre } \text{CaSO}_4$ is —— p.p.m.
Define Pilling and Bedworth rule.
Dacron is the polymer of ——.
What is azeotropic mixture?
Why is ethylene glycol added to water used in car radiator in cold countries?
Arrange benzene, ethylene, hexane and cyclohexane in the increasing order of their calorific values.
The absorbent of carbon monoxide in Orsat's apparatus is ——.
Define cetane number.
Why are gaseous fuels better than liquid fuel (three characters)?
Describe the lime-soda method of softening of hard water. Give chemical reaction involved in it.
How is hardness of water determined by soap titration method?

Calculate the amount of lime and soda required for softening $250 \text{ m}^3$ water containing following in mg/litre : $\text{Mg(HCO}_3)_2 = 2.19, \text{Ca(HCO}_3)_2 = 3.24, \text{MgSO}_4 = 2.4, \text{CaCl}_2 = 2.22, \text{Ca(NO}_3)_2 = 1.64, \text{CO}_2 = 2.2, \text{HCl} = 3.65, \text{NaHCO}_3 = 2.1$.
What is ideal solution? Explain positive and negative deviations from ideal behaviour of liquid pairs.
Deduce the relationship between elevation of boiling point of solution and the mole fraction of solute dissolved.

Two elements A and B form compounds $\text{AB}_2$ and $\text{AB}_4$ which do not dissociate or associate. When 1.0 g each $\text{AB}_2$ and $\text{AB}_4$ dissolved separately in 20 g benzene, lowers the freezing point 2.3 K and 1.3 K respectively. ($K_f$ for benzene = 5.1) Find atomic weight of A and B.
Write the construction, working and reactions involved in a dry cell.
What is galvanic series? Give its importance.

What is the pH of the solution of cell given below if its cell potential is 0.16 volt at $25 \text{ }^\circ\text{C}$? ($E^\circ_{M/M^{+2}} = 0.25 \text{ V}$) $M | M^{+2} (0.1 \text{ M}) || \text{HCl} (pH = ?) | \text{H}_2 (1 \text{ atm}); \text{Pt}$.
Explain the tacticity in polymer.
What is vulcanisation of rubber?
Give the preparation and uses of the following : (i) Bakelite (ii) Neoprene (iii) Nylon-6,6 (iv) ABC polymer.
Describe Fischer-Tropsch process for manufacturing of gasoline.
What are the significances of proximate and ultimate analysis of coal?

A coal sample was found to contain following composition by weight : $\text{C}=72, \text{H}=4, \text{O}=9, \text{S}=5, \text{N}=6$ and rest ash. (i) Find gross and net calorific value of coal. (ii) Find minimum amount of air by weight necessary for complete combustion of 1 kg coal (air contains 23% $\text{O}_2$ by weight).
